decision: Reprimand. 2nd Reprimand of the current season (Driving).
event_name: Time 19:53 2018 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 8 - 11 November 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 21) and heard the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Driving unnecessarily slowly on an in lap during Qualifying.
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction, document 2 (item 15.1).
penalty: Reprimand. 2nd Reprimand of the current season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, timing, and positioning data and heard from the driver and team representative of Car 20. Car 20 exceeded the specified maximum time between Safety Car Lines on its postqualifying In lap. The Stewards closely examined the drivers In lap and found that Car 20 took particular care not to impede other drivers. The driver also noted that he was concerned with the rain in the circumstances. However, the Stewards noted that other drivers were setting representative times at this moment, and that the delta time is based on 145% of a representative lap. Therefore the Stewards found that a breach was committed, but took into account the drivers concern about rain and imposed a reprimand.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
